:::{#sol-matrix-map-linear-practice}

Yes.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & -1 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

By @def-matvec-mult,

$$
\matr{A}\vx = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \cd x_1 + 2 \cd x_2 \\ 3 \cd x_1 + (-1) \cd x_2 \end{bmatrix}
= \begin{bmatrix} x_1 + 2 x_2 \\ 3 x_1 - x_2 \end{bmatrix}
= f(\vx).
$$

So $f$ multiplies its input by $\matr{A}$,
and $f$ is a [linear map](#def-linear-map) by @thm-matrix-map-linear.

:::
